title: gentianella luteomarginata
intro: Gentianella luteomarginata, commonly known as the Alpine Yellow-fringed Gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and aiding in respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella luteomarginata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its potential health benefits, including its use as an antispasmodic and antiussive agent, helping to relieve coughs and spasms.
